retaking.jaymoskingdoms.goal.ford: Find the ford below an old keep in a wood, where a road crosses water.
My father sat up every night with one eye on the stars and one on the door. Never missed a night in forty years.
Lights that move wrong. He never saw one. He said that was what the watching was for.
Sounds like a lot of lost sleep.
It was. Right up until the night it wouldn't have been, he'd say.
I'll keep an eye out too.
Good. Somebody ought to, now he's gone.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.retaking_book.o: You've read the warden's book. I can always tell. People come away from it looking over their shoulder for the one at the back.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.retaking_book.a: Do you know who he was?
No. My grandmother wouldn't even say "him" after dark. I took the hint.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.retaking_book.b: It's an old story, that's all.
Old, yes. I used to be surer of the rest.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.retaking_book.c: And the five who stood with them?
Gone, every one. Though some things don't stay gone, do they?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.retaking_ford.o: There's an old keep out in the woods, %2$s to the %1$s, above a river crossing. It's been standing empty longer than anyone can say. We stopped talking about it before I was born.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.retaking_ford.a: Hunters who did said their horses wouldn't drink at the ford. Just stood with their ears back, looking at the water.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.retaking_ford.b: Then you go and drink from it, and tell me how it tastes.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.retaking_ford.c: Nobody remembers. Somebody wrote names on the gatehouse once, I'm told. Whatever happened there, we forgot it on purpose.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.retaking_hardie: Past the last milestone the beasts have gone strange. Bigger. Meaner. My cousin says it started the day that giant came down.
That's how he put it. I told him giants come from the mountains. He just looked at me.
He does. He's also the only one of us who still goes out there.
Then I'll go and see for myself.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.retaking_lights: Saw one last month. A light coming down slow, nothing like a falling star. Next morning the farm out on the far road was empty.
Doors open, pot still on the fire. Not a soul. The pigs were gone as well, if that tells you anything.
You saw a star and a farmer moved.
Maybe. Moved in the night, and left his boots by the door?
Which way did it come down?
Over the hills. I didn't go and look. I'm not ashamed of that.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.retaking_counti: The dead walk thicker some nights. The priests won't say so. My grandmother said there's something at the bottom of the dark that keeps count.
Of us, I suppose. Who's left. She never said, and I never pushed her.
Grandmothers say a lot of things.
Mine was right about most of them. That's what worries me.
Then someone should go down and stop it counting.
Someone. Yes. I hear they're telling stories about someone.
They're making songs about you now, you know. The old ones, the way they used to about the five. I wonder how yours ends.
Nobody sings that part. The songs just stop, and everyone looks into their cups.
I'm no one from a song.
That's what everyone in a song says first.
No. That's why it's worth listening to.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.word.retaking_ford.v: further than anyone here has walked
